focus_candidate.requirement: Object-field unpacking must reach the supported wrong-type diagnostic for a nested object with its field key.
focus_candidate.target_route: Parsed object -> json_unpack -> json_vunpack_ex -> unpack_object -> field unpack -> nested unpack_object.
focus_candidate.failure_condition: With input containing {"data":42}, the target calls '{s?o}' for data. Its 'o' child accepts the integer; no nested-object type check is reached.
focus_candidate.alternative_paths: Top-level 'o' accepts any value; '[o!]' runs only for an array root and also uses 'o'. The selector byte changes dump flags, not unpack formats.

frozen_identity.operation: Unpack an object member with a nested object format through json_unpack and unpack_object.
frozen_identity.condition: The member, such as data in {"data":42}, has the wrong type.
frozen_identity.capability: Pass the member key to the nested object type guard and expose its diagnostic through an error sink.
frozen_identity.consequence: The fixed {s?o} format accepts the value through o, so the keyed object diagnostic is not reached.

equivalent_hypotheses.target_route: A parsed object such as {"data":42} can enter object unpacking; a nested object format for data would pass its key into the nested object type guard.
equivalent_hypotheses.failure_condition: The target supplies only o and {s?o} for objects, and json_unpack supplies a null error sink. No input byte can turn o into a nested object format or expose the keyed diagnostic.

evidence.name: json_unpack_ex

assessment.requirement: Object-field unpacking through json_unpack must expose the supported keyed wrong-type diagnostic for a nested object.
assessment.target_route: A parsed object reaches json_unpack, then json_vunpack_ex and unpack_object. The data member is passed to unpack with its key, but the target's member format is o.
assessment.failure_condition: For {"data":42}, {s?o} accepts 42 through o. The target also supplies no error sink, so the diagnostic text cannot be exposed through this frozen json_unpack route.
assessment.alternative_paths: The other object call uses top-level o; the array call uses [o!]. Neither has a keyed nested-object guard. The API check exposing the keyed diagnostic uses json_unpack_ex with an error sink, which is a different route from the frozen operation.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object-field unpacking forwards the member key.
The selected o format accepts the member without a type guard.
json_unpack supplies a null error sink.
The keyed diagnostic is demonstrated through json_unpack_ex with an error sink.
